svg.title: One family of Gaussians in three coordinate charts
svg.desc: The coordinate grid of the (mu, sigma) half-plane redrawn in moment coordinates (m1, m2) = (mu, mu^2 + sigma^2) and natural coordinates theta = (mu/sigma^2, -1/(2 sigma^2)). The Gaussian (1, 2) is the point (1, 5) in moments and (0.25, -0.125) in natural parameters.
svg.text: Blue: μ = −2, −1, 0, 1, 2. Orange: σ = 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3. The dot is the Gaussian (μ, σ) = (1, 2): (1, 5) in chart 2, (0.25, −0.125) in chart 3.
The set of Gaussians is the same in all three; only the labels differ, and the grid of chart 1 is bent by the change of labels.
